goal: Add importReview to src/lib/reviews/process-review.ts — an insert-only path that stores a review with sentiment classification and a completed review_ingested run-spine record, enqueues no generate_response, and never mutates an existing review row.
non_goals: Any behaviour change to processReview for the live-ingest, update, regenerate, or backfill lanes — behaviourally unaffected (the source of its new-review branch does change: the inline INSERT moves into a shared private helper)
Fixing the cross-lane lost-draft race documented in the plan's Hazards section — recorded on #675, which owns when the import actually runs
Consolidating the near-duplicate insertImportedReview in worker/jobs/zernio/zernio-ingest-shared.ts:364 (recorded as a note for #675)
Calling importReview from any worker, poller, or route — the caller is #675
Consent gating, offer expiry, the newest-100 cap / 12-month floor, and the reviews list (owned by #673/#675/#676/#677/#678/#679)
Any migration, feature flag, or env var
PHI screening — the caller screens reviews before handing them over (precedent: the processUnansweredReview closure inside handleZernioBackfill)
user_visible_behavior: None. importReview ships with zero callers and is inert until #675 wires it.
invariants: No behaviour change for any existing processReview caller — the live-ingest, update, and regenerate lanes are unaffected

Invariant #2 (transactional outbox): the review insert and its run-spine + analytics writes happen in exactly ONE sql.begin transaction; importReview has no follow-up work, so it writes no job_outbox row on any path
Invariant #3 (no unapproved posting): a review stored by importReview produces no responses row and no generate_response job, so nothing from this path can reach Google
Invariant #15: importReview takes its Sql client as an explicit parameter, matching processReview
Sentiment is classified at the write site (deterministic_star_v1), as at every other review-content write site
An import never mutates a review row the live lane already owns — an existing row means zero writes
An imported review's run_handler run is terminal on commit, so it can never surface as 'stalled' (deriveRunDisplayState, src/lib/agents/read.ts:127)
The shared INSERT binds its parameters in the canonical column order — a same-typed positional swap is caught mechanically, not by eye
edge_cases: Review already exists (ingested live earlier) → return 'unchanged', zero writes, even when the content hash differs
Concurrent writer wins the ON CONFLICT race → return 'unchanged', no re-read, no fall-through to the existing-row state machine
Account's first-ever review → first_review_ingested fires once; later reviews in the same import do not re-fire (earlier_exists guard + ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING)
Import of a review whose row exists but whose content changed → left for the live lane's next poll; the import does not update it
An imported review is never completed by a downstream worker (no draft, no publish), so importReview completes its own run in the insert transaction

rollback_plan: No migration and no schema change. importReview ships callerless, so reverting the single commit is operationally a no-op — no flag to flip, no data to back out. db_touching is true because src/lib/reviews/__tests__/import-review.integration.test.ts genuinely requires a provisioned test database.
observability: A completed review_handler run carrying a review_ingested step, with no responses row for the review, is the signature of an imported review — distinguishable from a live-ingest review, whose run stays open pending its draft.
Absence of a generate_response row in job_outbox for the imported review_id is the proof nothing was auto-drafted — assertable in test and queryable in staging.
No new log line: the function ships callerless. #675 owns the worker-level import counter/log signal; the map records epic-level observability as still open.
